'''Tanza's''' was a casino in [[Argovas City]], the capital city of the planet [[Argovia]]. It was a three story building made of [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] with bright lights and [[chrome]] statues. [[Sanchango]] was a popular game played at the establishment.

==History==
It was used as a landmark for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] strike team sent on the planet to [[Mission to Argovia|destroy]] the [[Imperial Sensor Net Complex]].
